description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, targeting Koll.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
